metadata.title: Convert Fraction Problems into Integer Conditions
metadata.description: Turn expressions with fractions into divisibility conditions, and solve short ratio or linear equations efficiently.

content.text: When a variable appears in the denominator, separate the integer part first. For example, (16n²+7n+6)/n becomes 16n+7+6/n, so integrality becomes a clean divisor condition.
For simple fractional equations, cross-multiplication is usually the cleanest path. For inequality chains, use transitivity instead of substituting random numbers.
Let's turn a fraction sum into a divisibility condition.
The common denominator is not the enemy. Use it only when needed; often the structure reveals the answer much faster.
